about: Where each file of build/apps-assets comes from and what its bytes are. The emulated bar serves these as /ext/apps_assets to the firmware's GUI and system apps; one set serves every firmware version. build.mjs checks the folder against this list before it builds anything, and stops if a file is there and not listed, listed and not there, or has other bytes than the sha256 here.

origins.firmware-build: Taken from the output of the firmware's own build (fbt, target f22: build/f22-firmware-D/resources/apps_assets) on 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-26. fbt converts each PNG to .image, each .zip of frames to .anim and each WAV to .snd, and copies fonts and scripts as they are. Which firmware commit that build was made from was not recorded. build.mjs --assets-from <that folder> takes these files again and records their new sha256 here.
origins.bar: Read by hand from a BUSY Bar running release 1.3.1 on 2026-11-09, file by file: GET /api/storage/read?path=/ext/apps_assets/<file>. They are converted files of the same kinds, as release 1.3.1 has them on a bar. The build never replaces them.

source: The file in the firmware repository, at the commit above, that the asset is made from.
sha256: SHA-256 of the file in build/apps-assets.
